Q1: Monobasic potassium phosphate exhibits a mixed hazard profile. It shows potential hazards related to carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive effects (CMR), and dermal/eye irritation (SKN) based on an expanded review of scientific literature and models (Tier 2). Conversely, studies support a favorable safety profile for inhalation (IHL) and oral (ORL) exposure (Tier 3). However, information regarding its environmental impact (ENV), endocrine disruption potential (EDC), and organ/systemic effects (OGN) is currently insufficient to make a confident assessment (Tier 4).
